none: PAS NLM-C5FC31: Roman Coin: Radiate of Tetricus I from Roxby cum Risby
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C TETR[ICVS PF AVG]

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate of Tetricus I (271-274), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP C TETR[ICVS PF AVG]. Reverse description: Female figure, possibly Pax holding sceptre in left hand and branch in right; legend lost. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 18.3mm, Weight: 2.28gms, die axis: 6
